expectations.text: File has YAML frontmatter with title, adr, status, date, authors, and changelog fields
expectations.evidence: File uses '# ADR 0001:' heading and bold **Status:**/**Date:** — no YAML frontmatter block

expectations.text: Document contains Motivation, Decision Drivers, Options, and Decision sections
expectations.evidence: Sections are: Context, Decision, Alternatives Considered, Consequences. No 'Motivation' or 'Decision Drivers' sections.

expectations.text: Each option lists pros and cons referencing the same named decision drivers
expectations.evidence: Alternatives Considered uses generic Pros/Cons bullets without referencing the named decision drivers (ops simplicity, reliability, team familiarity)

expectations.text: Document includes a Consequences section with at least one good and one bad consequence
expectations.evidence: Consequences section split into Positive, Negative/Risks, and Neutral subsections

expectations.text: ADR file is at docs/adrs/NNNN-*.md with zero-padded number and kebab-case name
docs/adrs/README.md exists and contains a table entry linking to the new ADR
